newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tankan shows Japan business outlook improved.
newsitem.headline: Tankan shows Japan business outlook improved.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" short-term corporate survey in November, released on Wednesday, showed that the business outlook among major manufacturers had improved since the previous survey in August.
BUSINESS DIFFUSION INDEX AUG NOV MARCH 1997
Major manufacturers -7 -3 -1
Major non-manufacturers -4 0 -1
Small manufacturers -17 -14 -12
Small non-manufacturers -7 -6 -8
(Note: In the previous survey in August, the index forecast for major makers was 0 for November. March figures are forecasts.)
SUPPLY AND DEMAND DIFFUSION INDEX AUG NOV MAR
Product supply/demand conditions -24 -21 -20
(Percentage of firms seeing demand exceeding supply
minus those seeing supply exceeding demand)
Finished goods inventories +16 +14 +8
(Percentage of firms saying inventories were excessive
minus those saying they were insufficient)
Product price change -16 -13 -9
(Percentage of firms saying product prices were rising
minus those saying they were falling)
EMPLOYMENT DIFFUSION INDEX AUG NOV MAR
(Percentage of firms saying they had excess workers
minus those saying they had insufficient workers)
Major firms +19 +17 +15
Manufacturers +23 +22 +19
Non-manufacturers +14 +12 +10
Small firms +3 -1 -3
Manufacturers +9 +5 +4
Non-manufacturers 0 -5 -6
CORPORATE FINANCE DIFFUSION INDEX AUG NOV MAR
Financial position - (percentage of firms describing their
situation as "easy" minus those seeing it as "tight")
Major firms +12 +12 +9
Bank lending attitude - (percentage of firms saying the
lending attitude of banks was "accommodative" minus
those calling it "severe")
Major firms +29 +29 +27
Change in borrowing rates - (percentage of firms saying
borrowing rates were rising minus those that said
they were falling)
Major firms +16 -25 +12
Liquidity ratio - (total corporate holdings of cash,
deposits and securities divided by average monthly
sales -- the higher the ratio, the more funds the firms
have on hand)
DEC(FORECAST) MAR(FORECAST)
Major firms +1.35 +1.29

The business diffusion index, a key gauge of corporate sentiment, measures the percentage of firms which expect their business environment to improve minus the percentage of firms which expect it to worsen. The survey covered 9,602 companies, of which 711 were categorised as large.
